findings.title: Current integration checkouts do not form the required source tuple
findings.evidence: Agent is 547e10456250c1b5bcf63b44a50c90ff0563ce1e/tree 68df11fad2b082fa12d99ca20404e1e40e350cd7; Runtime is 0ca306dfd3cf4e21976271cc4b2e779b10e025b0/tree 37cfcd4f6108c1fdda401e563e3674503bc328ef; App and Composition match the required tuple.

findings.title: Source receipt admission is producer-free and recursively searchable
findings.evidence: The checker accepts broad status/schema values, recursively searches arbitrary values for expected commit/tree/path strings, and independently validates local Git.
findings.attack_comparison: final2332 private control passed a producer-free synthetic JSON object with timeline.synthetic-forged/v1, status passed, producer untrusted, and expected receipt/path strings.

findings.title: Child receiver is not closed over the genuine provisioning result
findings.evidence: Maker emits a fixed provision report and flat success line with registered path/key, source markers, report path, and report SHA; receiver only checks loose alternate fields and presence of selected fields and does not bind child paths or report bytes.

findings.title: Kit receiver expects a different format from the current Farm producer
findings.evidence: Current Farm producer emits canonical timeline.farm-distribution-inputs.v1 JSON with roles/lock/distributions/ownership/component_identity and retains exact .farm-receipt.json bytes; receiver expects timeline.ops.* installed-kit JSON or a flat fallback.

findings.title: D73 parser is close to the producer shape but lacks retained-evidence closure
findings.evidence: Pinned launcher produces p4-d73-v1 key/value manifest, evidence copy, and runmanifest after exact tuple/path/Git checks; receiver byte-compares only the selected manifest and does not bind the evidence copy/runmanifest digest/path.

findings.title: Installed scripts are not live Farm receipts
findings.evidence: Kit scripts match the Composition source hashes and modes, but bench-store is absent and no current Farm receipt/registered child/evidence copy was bound. The shared Main venv schema distribution is not Farm admission evidence.

findings.title: C0 request/reply contract remains unchanged
findings.evidence: CommitRequest, accepted mutation, preview, and conflict shapes were read from the f103 schema and commit-v2 design; no product or wire files were changed.

findings.title: Required live Farm inputs remain missing
findings.evidence: No current four-checkout receipts, authenticated D139a/Farm receipt and schema carrier, registered child result, fresh D73 manifest/evidence, fresh poison copy, durable output roots, or normal service result were available or created.
findings.citation: prior return2322 evidence/missing-inputs.json; prior return2322 evidence/prerequisites.json

findings.title: Smallest source seam is the existing D140 receiver admission boundary
findings.evidence: Use exact existing producer formats and their path/byte/digest/source/registration closure; fail closed for unknown producer/schema/status/path/digest. Do not add a protocol, recursive keys, synthetic receipt, ledger, or wire change.
